yunlv-product-desc 1.0.3 Changelog

- Updated example use case: “竞品压制” has been renamed to “竞品分析” in use scenarios.
- No functional or API changes; documentation modifications only.

yunlv-product-desc v1.0.2

- Provides automated generation of differentiated, SEO-optimized product descriptions for foreign trade and B2B export platforms.
- Supports multi-language adaptation (up to 15 languages) and localization for different international markets and platforms.
- Features include value-based selling point extraction, competitor comparison, platform-specific output, and keyword optimization.
- Suitable for product launches, listing optimization, multilingual expansion, exhibition prep, and competitor suppression.
- Emphasizes content authenticity, platform compliance, and secure data handling—protecting user content and technical parameters.
Fix metadata: ensure consistency with passed skills

yunlv-product-desc 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Enables generation of differentiated, multi-language product descriptions for foreign trade across B2B and e-commerce platforms.
- Extracts 3–5 unique selling points from product parameters, avoiding homogenization and boosting inquiry conversion.
- Offers platform-specific formatting for Alibaba, independent sites, Amazon B2B, trade catalogs, and more, with built-in SEO optimization.
- Supports up to 15 languages, industry-specific vocabulary, and customization for market and application scenarios.
- Includes competitor comparison tables, specification formatting, and exportable content packages. 
- Built with strong privacy controls; only user-owned content is generated and stored.
